records.source_Japanese:
交易所
交易品の売買と情報収集を行います。
【！】「[[194|原産物]]」に属するアイテムを持って街の交易所に行くと、そのアイテムを譲ってくれるよう頼まれることがあります。アイテムを譲ると、その街の[[152|特産品]]が増えます。
→[[22|交易]]　→[[23|商業投資]]　→[[24|相場情報]]
records.previous_English:
Market
The market lets you buy and sell trade
goods and gather information. If you
bring a [[194|Source Item]] to a city's market,
you may be asked to hand it over. Doing 
so adds to that city's[[152| specialties.]] See
[[22|Trade,]][[23| Commercial Investment]] and
[[24|Market Info.]]
records.localization_note: Already names Market and Source Item consistently and explains the offer and handover. Keeps its original navigation.
records.english: Market The market lets you buy and sell trade goods and gather information. If you bring a [[194|Source Item]] to a city's market, you may be asked to hand it over. Doing so adds to that city's[[152| specialties.]] See [[22|Trade,]][[23| Commercial Investment]] and [[24|Market Info.]]
records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Town Commands link to the Market and its Trade, Commercial Investment and Market Info commands.
records.source_meaning: At the market, buy and sell trade goods and gather information. If you bring a Source Item, the city may ask to take it. Giving it to them adds a specialty.

records.source_Japanese:
商業投資（交易所）
街の商業育成をはかって投資します。１口～20口単位で投資できます。１口につき、街の発展度の50％分の金貨が必要です。
投資すると発展度が上がります。街の[[150|シェア]]合計が 100％に満たないか、または[[187|交戦中]]の勢力がシェアを所有しているときは、自勢力のシェアが上がります。発展度が高くなると、[[152|特産品]]が増えることがあります。
records.previous_English:
Commercial Investment 
Invest to develop a city's commerce. You
can invest 1 to 20 units at a time. Each
unit costs gold equal to half the city's
Growth. Investment raises Growth. Your
market share also increases if the city's 
total [[150|market share]] is below 100 percent 
or a faction you are[[187| at war with]] holds a
share there. Higher Growth may add new
[[152|specialties.]]
records.localization_note: Already explains investment units, cost and Growth and share conditions with the original cross-references.
records.english: Commercial Investment Invest to develop a city's commerce. You can invest 1 to 20 units at a time. Each unit costs gold equal to half the city's Growth. Investment raises Growth. Your market share also increases if the city's total [[150|market share]] is below 100 percent or a faction you are[[187| at war with]] holds a share there. Higher Growth may add new [[152|specialties.]]
records.speaker: Help system
records.context: The Market's Commercial Investment command. Also linked from Growth.
records.source_meaning: Invest in groups of 1 to 20 units. Each costs half the city's Growth in gold. Investment raises Growth and raises your share when the total is below 100 percent or a faction at war with you owns a share. Growth can add a specialty.

records.previous_English:
Workrooms 
These are the rooms and stations where
officers perform their assigned jobs. See 
[[111|Cabin,]][[112| Lounge,]][[113| Lumber Room,]][[114| Sickbay,]]
[[115|Galley,]][[116| Nursery,]][[117| Chapel,]][[118| Tactics Room,]]
[[119|Purser's Office,]][[120| Captain's Cabin,]]
[[121|First Mate's Office,]][[122| Helm,]][[123| Survey Room,]]
[[124|Lookout,]][[125| Mast]] and[[126| Deck.]]
records.localization_note: The Workrooms directory already names the Purser's Office correctly and preserves the other room links.
records.english: Workrooms These are the rooms and stations where officers perform their assigned jobs. See [[111|Cabin,]][[112| Lounge,]][[113| Lumber Room,]][[114| Sickbay,]] [[115|Galley,]][[116| Nursery,]][[117| Chapel,]][[118| Tactics Room,]] [[119|Purser's Office,]][[120| Captain's Cabin,]] [[121|First Mate's Office,]][[122| Helm,]][[123| Survey Room,]] [[124|Lookout,]][[125| Mast]] and[[126| Deck.]]
records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Shared Commands to Deck View to Workrooms. The article links to the Purser's Office.
records.source_meaning: Officers do their assigned work in these rooms or stations. The source links to all sixteen rooms and stations.

records.source_Japanese:
主計室（共通コマンド→甲板画面）
艦隊の会計を行う部屋です。
配置した航海士は「主計長」になります。配置できるのは、会計術 100以上の航海士です。
主計長がいると、交易所で値段をまけてもらえることがあります。また、倍の金額を出せば、商品を買い占められたりもします。ただし、倍の値段では売れません。
records.previous_English:
Purser's Office 
The fleet's accounts are managed here.
Officers assigned here become Pursers and 
need Finance 100 or higher. A Purser may
get you lower prices at the Trade House.
You may also be able to buy up all
available stock by paying twice 
the price, but you cannot sell
at twice the price.
records.heading: Purser's Office
records.english: This is where the fleet keeps its accounts. Assign an officer with Finance 100 or higher to serve as Purser. A Purser can sometimes get you a discount at the Market or buy up all available stock at twice the price. You cannot sell goods at twice the price.
records.localization_note: Keeps the role, skill threshold, conditional discount and buyout, and the restriction on selling at double price.
visible_lines: Purser's Office
This is where the fleet keeps its
accounts. Assign an officer with
Finance 100 or higher to serve as Purser.
A Purser can sometimes get you a discount
at the Market or buy up all available
stock at twice the price. You cannot sell
goods at twice the price.
records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Purser's Office in the Deck View workrooms. The role affects trading at the Market.
records.source_meaning: The fleet does its accounting here. An officer assigned here becomes Purser and needs Finance of at least 100. A Purser may get a lower price and may be able to buy out stock at double price. The double price does not apply to sales.

records.source_Japanese:
発展度（街データ）
街が発展している度合いを表します。
交易所で「[[23|商業投資]]」をすると上がります。
高くなると、街の特産品が増えることがあります。
また、集められる水夫の数や、装備できる大砲の種類も変化します。
records.previous_English:
Growth
Growth measures how developed a city is.
It increases when you make
[[23|commercial investments]] at the 
Trade House. As Growth rises, the city
may offer more specialties. The number of 
sailors you can recruit and the types of
cannon you can equip also change.
records.heading: Growth
records.english: Growth measures how developed a city is. It rises when you make [[23|commercial investments]] at the Market. Higher Growth may add to the city's specialties. It also affects how many sailors you can recruit and which cannon you can equip.
records.localization_note: Keeps the commercial investment link and the effects on specialties, recruitment and cannon.
visible_lines: Growth
Growth measures how developed a city is.
It rises when you make
commercial investments at the Market.
Higher Growth may add to the city's
specialties. It also affects how many
sailors you can recruit and which cannon
you can equip.
records.speaker: Help system
records.context: City Info links here. This article links to the Market's Commercial Investment command.
records.source_meaning: Growth measures a city's development. It rises with commercial investment at the Market. Greater Growth may add specialties and changes recruitment numbers and available cannon types.

records.source_Japanese:
特産品（街データ）
街で売却している交易品です。
街の発展度が高くなったり、原産物が持ち込まれると増えることがあります。
特産品は[[24|入荷月]]がくるたびに補充されます。
→[[194|原産物]]
records.previous_English:
Specialties 
Specialties are the trade goods sold in a 
city. A city may offer more as it 
develops or when products are delivered.
Stock is replenished each [[24|arrival month.]]
See [[194|Products.]]
records.heading: Specialties
records.english: Specialties are the trade goods sold in a city. A city may offer more as it develops or when someone brings in a Source Item. Stock is replenished each [[24|arrival month]]. See [[194|Source Item]].
records.localization_note: Distinguishes finished specialties from Source Items and preserves the stock replenishment rule and both links.
visible_lines: Specialties
Specialties are the trade goods sold in a
city. A city may offer more as it
develops or when someone brings in a
Source Item. Stock is replenished each
arrival month. See Source Item.
records.speaker: Help system
records.context: City specialty supply and its relationship to Commercial Investment and Source Items.
records.source_meaning: The trade goods a city sells are its specialties. Development or introduction of a Source Item can add to them. Specialties are restocked in their arrival months.

records.source_Japanese:
交易品データ
交易品のデータです。
交易品は、交易所で売買できる品です。街で売っている交易品を特産品といい、街ごとに異なります。
売買価格は街によって異なります。また、相場によっても価格は上下します。
基準の価格は、文化圏によって異なります。
→[[192|種類]]　→[[193|等級]]
records.previous_English:
Trade Goods 
Trade goods are bought and sold at the
Trade House. The goods sold in each city
are its specialties, and each city offers 
a different selection. Prices vary by 
city and change with market conditions. 
Base prices also vary by cultural region. 
See [[192|Types]] and[[193| Quality Grades.]]
records.heading: Trade Goods
records.english: Trade goods are bought and sold at the Market. The goods a city sells are its specialties, and every city has its own selection. Prices vary from city to city and rise or fall with market conditions. Base prices vary by cultural region. See [[192|Types]] and [[193|Quality Grades]].
records.localization_note: Keeps the distinction among city specialties, local price fluctuations and regional base prices.
visible_lines: Trade Goods
Trade goods are bought and sold at the
Market. The goods a city sells are its
specialties, and every city has its own
selection. Prices vary from city to city
and rise or fall with market conditions.
Base prices vary by cultural region. See
Types and Quality Grades.
records.speaker: Help system
records.context: The Data section links here, with separate pages on types and quality grades.
records.source_meaning: Trade goods are bought and sold at the Market. The goods sold in a particular city are its specialties. Prices vary by city and market conditions, and base prices vary by cultural region.

records.source_Japanese:
原産物
特産品の元となるアイテムです。
これを持って交易所に行くと、その街の特産品が増えることがあります。
原産物の特性に合わない街や、すでに特産品が５つある街では増えません。
【！】特性に合う街はいくつかあります。自勢力の[[150|シェア]]が高い街など都合のいい街で原産物を譲るとよいでしょう。
records.previous_English:
Products (Raw Materials)
Products can create new specialties in a
city. Bring one to the Trade House, and 
the city may gain a new specialty. This 
will not work if the city is unsuitable 
for the item or already has five
specialties. Several cities can suit the
same item. Consider giving it to a
convenient city, such as one where your 
faction has a high[[150| market share.]]
records.heading: Source Item
records.english: A Source Item can give a city a new specialty. Bring one to the Market in a suitable city with fewer than five specialties. More than one city can be a good fit for the same item. Choose a city that suits your plans, such as one where your faction has a high [[150|market share]].
records.localization_note: Matches the active item category. Keeps city suitability, the five-specialty cap, the possibility of several suitable cities and the advice about market share.
visible_lines: Source Item
A Source Item can give a city a new
specialty. Bring one to the Market in a
suitable city with fewer than five
specialties. More than one city can be a
good fit for the same item. Choose a city
that suits your plans, such as one where
your faction has a high market share.
records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Market and Specialties both link here. Market Share is the original outgoing link.
records.source_meaning: A Source Item is the basis of a specialty. Bringing one to the Market can add a specialty if the city suits the item and has fewer than five already. Several cities can qualify. Give the item in a city that works for you, such as one where your faction has a high share.
